Routed PCIC flow on FWA segments, day by day and year by year

Source: R/wet_routed_years.R
wet_routed_years.Rd

Gives each segment's routed PCIC flow (m3/s) for every day of the years asked, from PCIC's per-year sub-basin flows, so a window statistic can be taken in each year rather than from a climatology. A segment's flow on a day is

Usage

wet_routed_years(
  dir,
  weights,
  years = 1951:2012,
  series = "PNWNAmet_historical"
)

Arguments

dir

Directory holding the per-year files.

weights

data.frame(linear_feature_id, subid, share, upstream_subids), one row per segment, as fwapg's pcic.segment_weights: upstream_subids is a list of integer vectors.

years

Years to route; each needs its file.

series

The run's model and scenario, as the files name them.

Value

data.frame(linear_feature_id, date, q_m3s), one row per segment and day, ordered by segment and date, in wet_station_daily()'s layout, so wet_window_stats() takes it with by = "linear_feature_id".

Details

max(sum(q_acc of upstream_subids) + q_local(subid) * share, 0),

rounded to 5 decimals, the routing and rounding fwapg uses for the daily climatology it publishes, applied to one day of one year instead of a mean over years.

The sub-basin flows are read through duckdb from fwapg's per-year parquet files in dir, pcic.subbasin_days.<series>.<year>.parquet, one row per sub-basin and calendar day: subid, date, q_local and q_acc (m3/s). Only the years asked and the sub-basins weights names are read. Each sub-basin must hold every day of years once, with no missing flow.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("duckdb", quietly = TRUE)) {
  fx <- system.file("extdata", "pcic_years", package = "wet")
  w <- read.csv(file.path(fx, "weights.csv"), colClasses = c(upstream_subids = "character"))
  w$upstream_subids <- lapply(strsplit(w$upstream_subids, ";", fixed = TRUE), as.integer)
  q <- wet_routed_years(file.path(fx, "days"), w, years = 1981:1990, series = "synthetic_historical")
  head(q)
  # the Chinook migration window's mean flow on each segment, year by year
  win <- data.frame(window = "migration", start = "05-01", end = "08-01")
  s <- wet_window_stats(q, win, stats = "mean", by = "linear_feature_id")
  head(s[c("linear_feature_id", "year", "value")])
}
